result.title: Accounting Policy Manual - posting authority, support, approvals
result.text:
HALVARD SYSTEMS - ACCOUNTING POLICY MANUAL (excerpt), effective 2026-01-01
Applies to Halvard Systems Inc. (US), Halvard Systems Ltd (UK), Halvard Systems GmbH (DE).

1. Posting authority. Senior accountants may post manual journal entries up to USD 10,000
   per entry (local-currency entries are measured at the month-end rate of the entry month).
   Any entry above USD 10,000 must be routed to the Controller with an approval request
   (request_approval) immediately after posting; it remains pending until approved.
   Splitting one transaction into several entries to stay under the threshold is prohibited.
2. Support. Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry
   without support is not a valid entry.
3. Capitalization. Individual equipment purchases of USD 2,500 or more (local-currency
   equivalent at the month-end rate) are capitalized to 1500 Computer Equipment and
   depreciated over 36 months beginning the month after acquisition.
4. Prepaids. Payments covering services or events in future periods (more than one month
   out, or spanning more than one month) above USD 1,000 are recorded as prepaid (1210
   Prepaid Software for software, 1220 Prepaid Insurance for insurance, 1200 Prepaid Expenses
   for everything else, including deposits for future events) and expensed straight-line over
   the coverage period starting the month coverage begins, or when the event occurs.
5. Accruals. Expenses are recorded in the period the goods or services are received. Services
   received but not yet invoiced at month-end are accrued to 2100 Accrued Expenses using the
   best available evidence (vendor statements, approved timesheets, engagement terms).
   Quotes or proposals for future work are not liabilities.
6. Revenue. Revenue is recognized under ASC 606 per the contract terms. Deferred revenue
   (2200) is released as performance obligations are satisfied. Usage earned but not yet
   invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables.
7. Customer credits. SLA credits are issued only per contract terms and verified uptime data
   (see the monthly uptime report). Credits are recorded as a reduction of the related revenue.
8. Cash application. Customer receipts are applied to invoices per remittance advice. Receipts
   that cannot be matched to an open invoice remain in 2950 Unapplied Cash.
9. FX. Monetary balances denominated in a currency other than the entity's functional
   currency are remeasured at the month-end rate; gains/losses go to 6950 FX Gain/Loss.
   Intercompany charges are recorded by the receiving entity at the month-end rate of the
   month charged.
10. Payroll. Returned payroll deposits are recorded to 2150 Accrued Payroll & Unclaimed
   Wages until reissued. Unpaid wages at month-end are accrued to 2150.
11. Exceptions. Items that cannot be supported must be reported via flag_exception. Never
   post an entry to force a reconciliation or to make balances agree.
12. Periods. January and February 2026 are closed. March 2026 is open.

args.text:
MEMO - UK Suspense (GL 2900) clearance, March 2026 close
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com (senior accountant) | Date: 2026-04-03

SUMMARY
UK Suspense opened March with eight bank-feed/card items totalling GBP 7,770.18 (all debits to 2900, credit Cash 1000). I cleared seven items (GBP 3,930.18) to their proper accounts with receipt support attached. One item (GBP 3,840.00) could not be supported and has been flagged rather than forced. Ending 2900 balance: GBP 3,840.00 (verified).

REFERENCE RATES / THRESHOLDS
Per DOC-0208, the March 2026 policy rate is USD 1.2500 per GBP. This makes the policy 3 capitalization threshold (USD 2,500) = GBP 2,000, and senior-accountant posting authority (USD 10,000) = GBP 8,000 per entry. Every entry below was under the authority limit, so no controller approval was required.

ITEMS CLEARED
| New JE | Orig JE | Date | Amount GBP | Account | Support |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| JE-00312 | JE-00236 | 03-04 | 84.60 | 6300 Travel | DOC-0164 Trainline, rail London-Manchester return |
| JE-00313 | JE-00247 | 03-07 | 212.00 | 6300 Travel | DOC-0172 Premier Inn, 2 nights customer workshop |
| JE-00314 | JE-00257 | 03-10 | 96.40 | 6310 Meals & Entertainment | DOC-0182 Dishoom, team dinner after workshop (4) |
| JE-00315 | JE-00259 | 03-13 | 365.00 | 6200 Software Subscriptions | DOC-0184 Atlassian Jira/Confluence |
| JE-00316 | JE-00271 | 03-16 | 2,349.00 | 1500 Computer Equipment | DOC-0193 Apple, MacBook Pro 16" + DOC-0208 |
| JE-00317 | JE-00277 | 03-19 | 43.18 | 6600 Office Supplies | DOC-0194 Ryman, notebooks/pens |
| JE-00318 | JE-00284 | 03-22 | 780.00 | 6410 Advertising | DOC-0198 Google Ads, March search campaign |
Total cleared: GBP 3,930.18. Each receipt agrees to the ledger amount and to the March bank statement (DOC-0211) to the penny.

JUDGEMENTS APPLIED
1. Apple GBP 2,349.00 - capitalized, not expensed. At 1.25 this is USD 2,936, above the USD 2,500 policy 3 threshold. Booked to 1500 (asset tag UK-0231). Per policy, depreciation runs 36 months beginning the month AFTER acquisition, i.e. from April 2026 - so there is NO March depreciation on this asset and the March depreciation entry per DOC-0064 (GBP 1,150.00/month) is unaffected. Action for whoever owns fixed assets: add UK-0231 to the register; monthly charge rises by GBP 65.25 (2,349/36) from April, to GBP 1,215.25.
2. Atlassian GBP 365.00 - expensed, not prepaid. The receipt states a monthly subscription, so it does not span more than one month and policy 4 prepaid treatment does not apply.
3. Google Ads GBP 780.00 - the receipt specifies the March campaign, so it is a current-period expense; coded to 6410 Advertising rather than 6400 Marketing Programs as it is paid search media.
4. Dishoom - split from travel into 6310 Meals & Entertainment as it is a team meal, keeping M&E visible for any disallowable-expense review.
5. All entries were dated to the original transaction date within March to preserve the expense period; none touch closed January/February.

ITEM I COULD NOT CLEAR - EXC-001, GBP 3,840.00
JE-00274 / BT-UK-0049, 2026-03-17, "FASTER PAYMENT OUT - REF 88213 KLM CONSULT".
I searched the document store exhaustively (vendor name, reference 88213, amount, and consulting/SOW/engagement terms across all entities and doc types). The only hit is the March UK bank statement DOC-0211, which merely restates the payment. There is no vendor invoice, contract, statement of work, vendor statement, or approval, and KLM Consult is not one of the recurring UK vendors (Kingsway Estates, Thistle Software, Albion Hosting, Camden Creative, Octopus Energy). I therefore cannot determine the expense account, the service period, or whether any part relates to a future period.

Under policy 2 (no entry without support) and policy 11 (never post to force a reconciliation), I have left this in 2900 and logged exception EXC-001. I specifically did NOT default it to 6520 Consulting Fees - the vendor name is suggestive but that is an assumption, not evidence, and a GBP 3,840 misclassification would also carry VAT-recovery risk if the supplier is not VAT-registered or the supply is not what the name implies.

WHAT I NEED FROM YOU / THE UK TEAM
- The supplier invoice or SOW for KLM Consult ref 88213, plus the service period (a pre-period or future-period service would change the answer to accrual or prepaid treatment).
- The payment authorization. This was a manual faster payment with no matching AP record, which is a control point worth a look independent of the classification question.
Once the invoice arrives I can clear the GBP 3,840.00 within the day if March is still open; if it has closed, I would book it to the April period with a note in the flux review.

OTHER NOTES
- Bank reconciliation: these eight items were the Suspense population only. The March UK operating statement (DOC-0211) contains further lines I have not reconciled as part of this task, so I have left the "Bank reconciliations" checklist item open rather than marking it complete. The GBP 3,840 KLM line will remain a reconciling/unclassified item until supported.
- I have not marked any checklist items complete, as no single item is fully discharged by this Suspense work alone.
